findings.summary: Event-driven architecture exists only in staging: top-level declares no queue producer, no consumer, no DLQ, no R2. A top-level deploy runs every meaningful event through the synchronous service-binding fallback with nowhere to park failures.
Missed heartbeats create no event. Liveness is computed only inside handleInboundCall, so a charger that goes silent is never reported; the DO alarm is the outbound-command timeout sweep.
No scheduler of any kind — no Workflow and no cron trigger anywhere — so billing/report jobs have no runner and no failure alert.
findings.evidence: zero workflows/triggers keys in any wrangler config

findings.summary: Five environments declare neither routes nor workers_dev; adding a route infers workers_dev=false and removes a host the shipped Flutter client pins with no runtime override.
No Worker version id has ever been recorded, so no release has a rollback target.
